body.title: Garage conversion
body.markdown:
The single garage at 12 Maple Street becomes Jane's home office, and the homelab rack moves out of the damp basement into it.

```gantt
title: Garage conversion
## Planning
Get quotes [quotes]: 2026-05-04, 10d, done
Building permit [permit]: after quotes, 2w, done
## Building
Insulation and drywall [walls]: after permit, 2w, 80%
Electrics and network cabling [cable]: after walls, 8d
Floor [floor]: after cable, 6d
Paint [paint]: after floor, 5d
## Homelab
Move the rack [rack]: after paint, 4d, orange
Switch and access point [ap]: after rack, 3d, orange
Office ready: 2026-07-27
```

The electrician needs the network outlets marked on the floor plan before the drywall closes.
